svg.desc: CoC2 Center of Excellence LOCATION Maghagha City, Menya, Egypt CLIENT Ministry of Education - Misr El Kheir Foundation Funded by: KFW STATUS EST. VALUE In Progress N/A DISCIPLINES Urban Planning & Design Landscape Design Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview The project involves the architectural design of Competence Centers located in Maghagha City, Minya Governorate. An existing technical industrial secondary school building has been selected for redesign. The building has a distinctive identity with unique architectural features, which are intended to be preserved and integrated into a new, modern campus for Competence Center 2
